load_params_from_checkpoint: load model params from an orbax checkpoint path with optional quantization and sharding
save_params_to_checkpoint: save model params to an orbax checkpoint directory with optional wait until finished
load_checkpoint_into_train_state: use LoadCheckpoint to load Gemma weights into a Kauldron TrainState with quantization support
release_jax_array_memory: release and delete memory of JAX arrays in a params tree using release_memory
convert_checkpoint_structure: convert checkpoint params between NESTED FLAT STACKED and KAULDRON structures using _CheckpointTree
